meta.title: A surrogate bid picks up the vendor's first make where makes exist

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the round counts the new bid.

plan.title: A surrogate bid picks up the vendor's first make where makes exist

assert.say: the round counts the new bid
